name: Queen's Gambit (master statistics)
description: Grown from master games alone, for comparing ways of making books: White plays the most played move, and Black gets every common reply.
rules: From d4 d5 c4; White plays the most played move; the other side every reply played in at least 8% and 100 of the position's master games; to ply 20, at most 1000 positions, from position_cache only
